description: Generate an AI summary of all done phases in a workflow's project plan, save it as a context file in the specified library, then delete the source phases. Updates the plan's last_summarized_at timestamp.

libraryId.description: Library ID to save the summary file into.

summaryTitle.description: Title for the summary file, e.g. "Auth Rewrite — June 2026".

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your configured workspace.

name: summarize_done_phases
